    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import math\n",
        "r = float(input(\"ingrese el valor del radio\\n\"))\n",
        "theta = float(input(\"ingrese el ángulo theta en radianes\\n\"))\n",
        "X = r * math.cos(theta)\n",
        "Y = r * math.sin(theta)\n",
        "print(f\"las coordenadas cartesianas son\\n\")\n",
        "print(f\"x = {X}\")\n",
        "print(f\"y = {Y}\")"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "hSPdc7AhaoGU",
        "outputId": "2122861d-3c80-42ac-c48e-71837831d55a"
      },
      "execution_count": 6,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "ingrese el valor del radio\n",
            "8\n",
            "ingrese el ángulo theta en radianes\n",
            "9\n",
            "las coordenadas cartesianas son\n",
            "\n",
            "x = -7.2890420950774155\n",
            "y = 3.2969478819340527\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "v0 = 35.0\n",
        "theta = 42.0\n",
        "g = 9.81\n",
        "\n",
        "theta_rad = np.deg2rad(theta)\n",
        "\n",
        "T_vuelo = (2 * v0 * np.sin(theta_rad)) / g\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"T_vuelo = {T_vuelo:.4f} s\")\n",
        "\n",
        "t = np.linspace(0, T_vuelo, 200)\n",
        "\n",
        "x = v0 * np.cos(theta_rad) * t\n",
        "y = v0 * np.sin(theta_rad) * t - 0.5 * g * t**2\n",
        "\n",
        "print(t)\n",
        "print(x)\n",
        "print(y)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.plot(x, y)\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"x (m)\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"y (m)\")\n",
        "plt.title(f\"Trayectoria del proyectil - Tiempo de vuelo: {T_vuelo:.4f} s\")\n",
        "plt.grid()\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],
